title: PacPack Voxydized Server
description: Server version of the PacPack Voxydized modpack
body:
# 🌌 PacPack Voxydized - Server Version

Welcome to the official server pack for [PacPack Voxydized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pacpack-voxydized). This pack is pre-configured for high performance and stability on Fabric 1.21.11.

---

## 🚀 How to Start the Server

1. **Java Requirement:** Make sure you have **Java 21** installed (required for Minecraft 1.20.6+).
2. **Accept the EULA:** 
   - Open the `eula.txt` file.
   - Change `eula=false` to `eula=true` and save.
3. **Configure Memory:** - Open `user_jvm_args.txt` to adjust your RAM allocation (`-Xmx8G` is recommended).
4. **Launch:** - Run `startserver.bat` to start your world!

---

## 📁 File Structure

* **fabric-server-mc.1.21.11-loader.0.18.4-launcher.1.1.1.jar**: The official Fabric executable. We kept the original name for transparency and version tracking.
* **startserver.bat**: Your one-click launch script.
* **user_jvm_args.txt**: The dedicated file for your custom JVM arguments and RAM settings.
* **mods/**: Optimized server-side mod list : 
  - Client-only mods have been removed for stability
  - Server-only mods have been added for more customization, like [TAB](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tab-was-taken) or [X Backup](https://modrinth.com/mod/x-backup).
* **config/**: Performance-tuned configurations for the 1.21.11 environment.

---

## 💡 Server Tips

* **Voxy & View Distance:** While players use Voxy for massive render distances, the server's `view-distance` (in `server.properties`) defines how many "real" chunks are ticked. We recommend a value between **10 and 16** for a good balance.
* **Lootr:** This mod is active! Every player opening a chest for the first time will get their own unique loot. No more empty dungeons for late-comers.
* **Compatibility:** Ensure your players are using the **PacPack Voxydized** modpack in the same version as this one to connect without issues.

---
If you encounter any issue, feel free to come on Discord and describe your problem.

*Developed by the PacPack Team. Thank you for using our modpack!*
